key.name: usb-printers
key.summary: USB printer passed through to each printer application
key.description: Maps a printer family ID (ghostscript, ps, hplip, gutenprint) to the identity of the USB printer that family's application may use, as 'vendor:product:serial' with the four-digit hexadecimal USB vendor and product IDs. The serial is empty for a printer that reports none. A family with no entry is given no USB printer.
